doc: Bar interior in Palm Brinks (i02h03). The map's own code places the player at the door and, at story progress 100, has villagers talk about where Claire is; otherwise talk goes to the large shared town talk library with the quest-giving and joining villagers (Milane, Gerald, Need, Bruno, Rufio, Fabio, Olivie, Mina, Corinne, Granny Rosa).
